faqs.q: What is Geared Beam Trolley, Type B used for?
faqs.a: Geared Beam Trolley, Type B is a geared beam trolley: a hand-chain geared trolley that carries a hoist along the flange of an I-beam and moves it by pulling the hand chain. It is listed in 7 sizes, 0.5 t to 10 t.

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Geared Beam Trolley, Type B, such as IH-LR-BT-GB-0T5?
faqs.a: Geared Beam Trolley, Type B part numbers begin with IH-LR-BT-GB and end in a size code: IH-LR-BT-GB-0T5 is the 0.5 t size and IH-LR-BT-GB-10T is the 10 t size. Quote the full part number from the size table, or give us the size and the load you need, when you enquire.

faqs.q: What sizes does Geared Beam Trolley, Type B come in?
faqs.a: Geared Beam Trolley, Type B is listed in 7 sizes, 0.5 t to 10 t, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-LR-BT-GB-0T5 and IH-LR-BT-GB-10T. The table includes 0.5 t: weight 12 kg and 10 t: weight 100 kg.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Geared Beam Trolley, Type B?
faqs.a: Size the trolley on the combined weight of hoist and load, and on the beam flange width it adjusts to. For Geared Beam Trolley, Type B the table gives the flange range for each of the 7 sizes, with 0.5 t suiting a 75-125 mm flange and 10 t a 125-180 mm flange.

faqs.q: What capacity does Geared Beam Trolley, Type B cover?
faqs.a: Geared Beam Trolley, Type B is rated 0.5 t to 10 t in capacity, with the working load set by the size you choose. For example the 0.5 t size weighs 12 kg and the 10 t size 100 kg. The trolley must carry the hoist and the load together.

faqs.q: What material and finish is Geared Beam Trolley, Type B supplied in?
faqs.a: The listing for Geared Beam Trolley, Type B does not state the material or the finish. Tell us the environment it will work in and any material standard or coating you need, and we confirm what the maker can supply before you order.

faqs.q: What standard and certificate apply to Geared Beam Trolley, Type B?
faqs.a: For Geared Beam Trolley, Type B, the listing gives its documentation as: Manufacturer's test certificate. For third-party certification or a witnessed proof test, say so on the RFQ before the order is placed.

faqs.q: What does Geared Beam Trolley, Type B connect to or work with?
faqs.a: For Geared Beam Trolley, Type B, the trolley carries a hoist such as a [manual chain block](/c/chain-blocks-manual-hoists) or an [electric hoist](/c/electric-hoists) and runs on an I-beam whose flange falls inside its adjustment range.

faqs.q: How should Geared Beam Trolley, Type B be inspected and looked after?
faqs.a: For Geared Beam Trolley, Type B, before use check that the trolley wheels sit square on the flange, the stops are fitted at the beam ends, the side plates are not bent and the hand chain runs freely. A competent person should inspect the trolley periodically.

faqs.q: How does Geared Beam Trolley, Type B differ from Geared Beam Trolley — Type C?
faqs.a: Geared Beam Trolley, Type B differs from [Geared Beam Trolley — Type C](/p/geared-beam-trolley-type-c) in its size range 0.5 t to 10 t against 0.5 t to 20 t; weight 12 to 100 kg against 14 to 245 kg.

faqs.a: Yes. We ship Geared Beam Trolley, Type B from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the part numbers, quantities and delivery country through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.q: Do you keep Geared Beam Trolley, Type B in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. Geared Beam Trolley, Type B is in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, with worldwide shipping and the best lead times. Tell us the part numbers, quantities and destination on [the contact page](/contact) and we will quote.
